oracle.statement: the registry relation R holds for every probe - optimizations(n)==200 <=> describe(n)==200 <=> n listed, and optimizations(n)==404 <=> describe(n)==404 <=> n not listed - on (MR1) each self-created collection, (MR2) a never-created unique-prefix name, and (MR3) a collection immediately after its 200 delete ACK (face flips to 404 together with describe, never lagging or phantoming); any cross-face disagreement on a name = Type4_StateLogicViolation; 5xx with /healthz alive = Type3_RuntimeFailure; transport failure with healthy /healthz or create/drop setup-premise failure = SCRIPT_ERROR
